description: Email authentication DNS audit for a domain or email address: SPF with recursive 10-lookup count and all qualifier, DMARC policy, pct and report addresses, DKIM selector probe, MTA-STS with policy file, TLS-RPT, BIMI and MX. Useful for deliverability checks, Google/Yahoo bulk-sender readiness and spoofing risk. Returns grade A-F, score, spoofable flag, parsed records and plain-language issues. Errors: 400 invalid domain, 404 NXDOMAIN. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/dns/email-auth.

domain.description: domain or email address, e.g. paypal.com

selectors.description: optional comma-separated DKIM selectors to probe (max 12); default probes 12 common ones

name: email_auth_audit
title: Email auth DNS audit (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MTA-STS)
